title: Functional French – High Intermediate II
prerequisites_raw: FSL305H5 or the equivalent as determined by the department's French Placement Test ( https://frenchpt.utm.utoronto.ca/ ).
exclusions_raw: FRE180H5 or FRE181H5 or FSL305Y5 or FSL221Y1 or FSL222H1 or higher level FSL course, all high school grade levels in French Immersion, Extended French, and French Secondary Schools.
